full_prompt_en: A square, dreamlike photographic composite shows a small figure in a vivid red coat standing on a pale snowy ridge beneath an immense orange tree, against a cold blue-gray sky. The sky fills most of the frame and darkens toward its upper edge, with a softly mottled, grainy surface rather than a clear horizon. At the upper left, scattered tiny black bird silhouettes drift through the open air in a loose, irregular group. Across the upper right, the tree's broad crown spreads in a dense cloud of burnt orange and rust leaves; its finest outer twigs dissolve into the cooler background. A dark, roughly textured trunk rises from the ridge near the right edge, widening into shadowed branches within the foliage. Near the lower center, the lone upright figure appears very small relative to the tree, its red outer garment forming a clean, intense vertical accent. The face and individual features are too distant to read, while dark legs and feet connect the figure to the bright ground. The narrow upper surface of the ridge runs across the lower quarter, glowing with a thin line of pale light. Below that line, rough blue-gray snow and earth fall into darker shadow, with uneven, almost sculpted marks that make the foreground tactile. Soft, cool light comes from the open sky and brightens the snow along its crest; the orange canopy and red coat remain the only warm, saturated notes. Atmospheric haze softens distant boundaries, while subtle grain and layered tonal transitions give the scene a painterly photographic finish. The overall composition balances a tiny solitary presence, an expansive canopy, and generous dark sky in a quiet, surreal contrast of warm color and wintry blue.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、梦境般的摄影合成画面里，一个穿鲜红外衣的小人站在浅色雪脊上，旁边是一棵巨大的橙色树，背景是寒冷的蓝灰天空。天空占据画面大部分，向上缘逐渐变暗，表面带柔和斑驳的颗粒感，没有清楚的地平线。左上方，一群细小的黑色鸟影松散而不规则地掠过空旷天空。右上方，树冠以密集的焦橙和铁锈色叶片大幅铺开，最外侧的纤细枝梢融入冷色背景。粗糙暗色的树干从靠右的雪脊上升起，在叶簇里分成隐于阴影的枝条。下方中央附近，独立站立的人物相对于树显得很小，红色外衣形成清晰而强烈的竖向色彩焦点。距离使面容与细部无法辨认，深色腿脚则把人物稳稳接到明亮地面上。雪脊狭窄的上表面横贯画面下四分之一，沿边缘泛着一道浅色亮光。亮线下方，粗粝的蓝灰积雪与土层沉入较深的阴影，不均匀、近乎雕刻般的痕迹让前景具有触感。柔和冷光来自开阔天空，照亮雪脊顶端；橙色树冠与红色外衣是画中仅有的暖色高饱和音符。朦胧空气柔化远处边界，微细颗粒和层叠的明暗过渡赋予场景绘画般的摄影完成面。整体构图以渺小孤独的人物、宽阔的树冠与大片深色天空相平衡，在暖色与冬季蓝调的对照中显得安静而超现实。
style_prompt_en: The image has a dreamlike photographic-composite finish, with broad atmospheric color fields surrounding a few sharply readable accents. Cool slate, blue-gray, and charcoal occupy most of the space, while concentrated rust orange and vivid red create a small number of powerful focal areas. Large soft-edged masses meet delicate, irregular dark marks, and the smallest details scatter rather than form an even pattern. The surface carries fine grain, faint haze, and tactile roughness; tonal transitions feel layered rather than digitally flat. Diffuse cool illumination picks out narrow pale highlights against deep foreground shadow. A low horizontal division leaves ample negative space above, while one broad organic mass counters a tiny concentrated accent. The overall effect is hushed and surreal, with striking scale contrast held inside restrained, wintry light.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有梦境般的摄影合成质感，宽阔的大气色域围绕少量清楚易读的视觉强调。冷石板色、蓝灰与炭黑占据大部分空间，集中出现的铁锈橙与鲜红形成少数有力焦点。大片柔边形体与纤细、不规则的深色笔迹相接，最小的细节呈散布状态，而不排成均匀纹样。表面带细颗粒、淡薄雾气和可触摸的粗糙感；明暗过渡层层叠合，没有数码平涂的生硬。漫射冷光在深色前景阴影旁勾出狭窄的浅色高光。较低的水平分界让上方保留充足负空间，一片宽阔的有机形体与小而集中的色彩强调相互制衡。整体效果安静而超现实，强烈的尺度反差被克制的冬季光线包裹。

theme_zh: 雪脊上红衣小人站在秋树旁
